:::: {#hero}

I turn messy, high-dimensional data into **models, maps and dashboards that people use to make decisions**.
I have 8+ years of experience across academia, public health and health insurance, and a PhD in
Epidemiology & Biostatistics from The University of Queensland.

Right now I work as a **Data Scientist at HBF** in Perth, Australia. I build analytics on insurance
claims data in Snowflake, Python and SQL, and ship Tableau dashboards and Streamlit apps.

::: {.hero-cta}
[View projects](projects.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .me-2}

## {{< fa chart-line >}} What I do {.section-heading}

::::: {.grid .ds-grid}

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-3 .ds-card}
### {{< fa brain >}} Statistical & ML modelling
Bayesian inference, regression (GLMs, Poisson/binomial), and predictive models that flag at-risk populations.
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-3 .ds-card}
### {{< fa globe >}} Geospatial analytics
Geostatistical models, raster pipelines and high-resolution maps for disease surveillance and elimination planning.
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-3 .ds-card}
### {{< fa database >}} Data engineering
ETL pipelines and data models in Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, SQL Server and Power Query, built to scale to billions of rows.
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-3 .ds-card}
### {{< fa chart-pie >}} Dashboards & storytelling
Power BI and Tableau dashboards, plus Streamlit apps that turn numbers into narratives for executives.
::::
